meta.name: buzz-community
meta.description: Build and manage open source community — Discord/Slack structure, contributor onboarding, ambassador program, community flywheel design, and GitHub community health. Use when asked to "build a community", "grow our Discord", "improve contributor experience", or "design a developer ambassador program".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计并管理开源社区，优化贡献者体验。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在运营或启动一个开源社区。
copy.tagline_en: Design and manage an open source community to improve contributor experience.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are running or starting an open source community.

howto.what: 它会评估社区当前阶段（种子/增长/飞轮），然后设计 Discord/Slack 频道结构、GitHub 社区健康文件、贡献者入门流程、大使计划，并输出一份包含平台结构、规则、SLA 和指标的社区手册。
howto.when: 当你要求“构建一个社区”、“发展我们的 Discord”、“改善贡献者体验”或“设计开发者大使计划”时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个开源社区的大使计划。
say.note: 它会输出大使资格、权益和职责的完整方案。

say.text: 如何改进贡献者的首次体验？
say.note: 它会给出从发现项目到合并PR的步骤和优化建议。

say.text: 为我的 Discord 社区规划频道结构。
say.note: 它会提供从公告到贡献者分类的频道列表和用途说明。

howto.what_en: It assesses the community stage (Seed/Momentum/Flywheel), then designs Discord/Slack channel structure, GitHub community health files, contributor onboarding flow, ambassador program, and produces a community playbook with platform structure, rules, SLAs, and metrics.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "build a community", "grow our Discord", "improve contributor experience", or "design a developer ambassador program".

say_en.text: Design an ambassador program for my open source community.
say_en.note: It outputs full qualification, benefits, and responsibilities.

say_en.text: How to improve the first-time contributor experience?
say_en.note: It gives steps from discovery to PR merge and optimization tips.

say_en.text: Plan my Discord community channel structure.
say_en.note: It provides a full channel list from announcements to contributors.
